password-managers.sentence: sleight refuses password managers because they contain passwords and other secrets. The user must operate this app.
password-managers.cardRisk: Claude could read or change passwords and other secrets in this app.

terminals.sentence: sleight refuses terminals because they can run commands. Only the user may lift this restriction with ComputerUseAllowForbiddenTargets.
terminals.cardRisk: Claude could type and run commands in this terminal.

authentication-agents.sentence: sleight refuses authentication dialogs. The user must answer the authentication request.
authentication-agents.cardRisk: Claude could approve authentication or change who has access.

protected-system-surfaces.sentence: sleight refuses this system app because it controls the desktop, accessibility or login session. The user must operate it.
protected-system-surfaces.cardRisk: Claude could control the desktop and session or change accessibility access.

agent-hosts.sentence: sleight refuses agent hosts because Claude could approve another agent's actions or its own requests. The user must operate this app.
agent-hosts.cardRisk: Claude could approve another agent's actions or its own requests in this app.
agent-hosts.overrideSentence: sleight refuses this OpenAI app because Claude could approve another agent's actions. Only the user may lift this restriction with ComputerUseAllowForbiddenTargets.

settings-windows.sentence: sleight refuses this settings window so Claude cannot change approval or safety settings. Claude must ask the user.
settings-windows.cardRisk: Claude could change approval or safety settings in this window.

secure-input.sentence: sleight refuses key input during secure input, and other input when its status is unknown. The user must finish secure input or restore its status.
secure-input.cardRisk: Key input could enter a secret or answer a prompt while secure input is active.

secure-field.sentence: sleight refuses key input and semantic writes while a secure field has focus or its status is unknown. The user must enter the secret or restore focus status.
secure-field.cardRisk: Key input or a semantic write could change a secret while a secure field has focus.
